pdf-redaction.name: pdf-redaction
key_points: NEVER use draw_rect or overlay rectangles for redaction — `page.draw_rect()` draws on top of text but doesn't remove it from extraction. Only `add_redact_annot()` + `apply_redactions()` actually removes text.
pdf-redaction.description: Redact text from PDFs for anonymization, blind review, or privacy — PyMuPDF search+annotate pipeline with verification.
pdf-redaction.scope: Redact text from PDFs for anonymization, blind review, or privacy — PyMuPDF search+annotate pipeline with verification.

skillsbench-host-grading.name: skillsbench-host-grading
key_points: ALWAYS write deliverables to the task directory (`tasks/<id>/`), NOT to `/root/` on the host. Verifier only stages task dir files.
Dockerfile RUN commands do NOT execute during host verification — host staging copies files from the task tree; it never builds Docker images. Pre-compute outputs as static files in the task root.
DO NOT rely on solution/ to generate deliverables — `solution/` is excluded from staging. Run your script and commit the output to the task root.
ALWAYS read `tests/test_outputs.py` before writing output — it defines the exact JSON schema, field names, tolerance (e.g., `rel_tol=0.001`), and file paths the verifier checks.
